about: Tex as it runs: every step, its model, effort, on or off, time limit, rounds and the context it reads in order, and every wire. The Tex Architecture Lab opens this as main and promotes a version by changing this file in a pull request; the gateway reads it. Nothing else holds these values (Dev2, 2026-11-13).

door.label: Door steps
door.goal: Gather what the turn needs (who's asking, the chat's home, settings, history) in code, before any model runs.

nodes.label: Check-in
nodes.goal: Three times a day, look at what changed in their workspace, mail and calendar, and text them only what can't wait; most looks stay quiet. Runs the front door with its own read-only tools and setup model.

nodes.label: Routine runs
nodes.goal: Run a routine note under tex/routines/ on its schedule, as the person who wrote it, and text what it found unless it has nothing to say.

nodes.label: Send through Tex
nodes.goal: Another AI connected to Context asks Tex to text the person (send notify) because something needs them now; their settings decide whether it goes, and it is texted as written, with no model.

nodes.label: A text arrives
nodes.goal: Take every text, picture or tapback from iMessage or WhatsApp and get it into the chat's record before anything decides about it.

nodes.label: Decide
nodes.goal: Choose, from labelled examples, whether this text gets an answer, a reaction, a short wait or nothing, so Tex never answers what wasn't for it.

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.goal: Keep one turn per chat at a time (groups up to three side by side) so two answers never race each other.

nodes.label: Read the text
nodes.goal: Read the request: who is asking, from which chat, and what they asked.

nodes.label: Run a routine
nodes.goal: For a routine's run: reload the routine, and stop here when it is paused or its job needs no model.

nodes.label: Check the question
nodes.goal: Check the question and what came with it: the files, the message it replies to, the tapbacks.

nodes.label: Settle a yes or no
nodes.goal: A texted yes or no settles a waiting approval here, in code, before any model runs.

nodes.label: Watch what leaves
nodes.goal: Start this turn's egress ledger: what it reads from outside and what it may send out.

nodes.label: Check it may run
nodes.goal: Start reading the tools and the history, and check the model may run here.

nodes.label: Read the history
nodes.goal: Hear voice messages, keep sent files, and read the chat's history and the tools offered.

nodes.label: Open the web
nodes.goal: Pick the write tools for this chat and open the browser, vouched for by the person's own words.

nodes.label: Read the setup
nodes.goal: Read Tex's setup: its prompt, history length, skills, models, router and fallback.

nodes.label: Bookkeeping
nodes.goal: Prepare what the turn records: usage, the turn log, the ledger turn id, the pictures to keep.

nodes.label: Prepare the answer
nodes.goal: Start the side read of Tex's notes and set up the answer checks and pictures.

nodes.label: Router
nodes.goal: Send a plain lookup to a cheaper path and keep the front door for changes and thinking.

nodes.label: Front door
nodes.goal: Write Tex's answer: read the chat, call the tools that do the work, and draft the reply.

nodes.label: Fallback
nodes.goal: Answer when the front door's model is down, so a text never goes unanswered.

nodes.label: Big-ask planner
nodes.goal: Break a big ask into steps before the front door starts, so it doesn't wander.

nodes.label: Tools
nodes.goal: Do the actual work in Context and the world: read, write, manage and send. Added only in code.

nodes.label: Advisor
nodes.goal: Think harder when the front door is stuck, and say what to try next.

nodes.label: Answer checks
nodes.goal: Catch what code can prove wrong in a draft (a claim with no call behind it, a missing link) before a model looks.

nodes.label: Mail checker
nodes.goal: Read an email before it goes and stop one that is wrong, rude or to the wrong person.

nodes.label: Card check
nodes.goal: Check a card's fields match what was asked before it is shown.

nodes.label: Reply reviewer
nodes.goal: Read the draft as the person would and send it back when it misses, so they never get a wrong or lazy answer.

outSchema.name: kind
outSchema.options: task, question, chat, correction, report, scheduled

nodes.label: Text them
nodes.goal: Deliver the answer: the texts, any card, and a reaction, as the chat's service allows.

outSchema.name: card
outSchema.options: a link card, when there is one

outSchema.name: reaction
outSchema.options: a tapback on their text, or none

nodes.label: React
nodes.goal: Put Decide's tapback on their text straight away, so a thanks or a win gets a reaction without a reply.

outSchema.name: emoji
outSchema.options: Decide's pick, if on the allowlist

nodes.label: Classifier
nodes.goal: File each text into a conversation thread after the reply, so later turns see a short index instead of everything.

nodes.label: Self-review
nodes.goal: Look back at a sent answer and note what to do better next time.

nodes.label: Background job
nodes.goal: Do long work (browsing, forms, many steps) without holding up the reply.

nodes.label: Job check
nodes.goal: Check a job's work as it goes and steer it when it drifts.

nodes.label: Advisor on job mail
nodes.goal: Decide what to tell the person when a job gets mail it can't handle alone.

nodes.label: Hand-back judge
nodes.goal: Make sure what a job hands back is true and finished before the person hears it.
